genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. EURC is issued solely by Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS and redeemable 1:1 for euros. MiCA authorization and U.S. group affiliate charters do not establish EURC GENIUS permission. Circle GENIUS readiness and charter statements concern USDC; no EURC/Circle Europe-specific intent or application was established. August 2026 EURC reserve examination covers August 11 and August 31, with management assertion dated September 29, 2026. GENIUS remains pre-effective in the reviewed public implementation sources; the expected effective date is January 18, 2027, with the general DASP offer/sale ban separately beginning July 18, 2028. Foreign lawful-order requirements attach at Act effectiveness. Foreign exception remains unknown.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: In the public sources checked on 2026-10-07, no token-specific GENIUS PPSI approval, state qualification, official application, OCC foreign-issuer registration or Treasury foreign comparability determination was found for EURC / Circle Internet Financial Europe SAS. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no confidential application exists. No token-specific public U.S. regulatory action was located. Existing charters and foreign licenses are not GENIUS approval.
